newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in narrow range, could ease overnight.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in narrow range, could ease overnight.

text.p: The ringgit was stuck in a narrow trading range as a technical rebound from 2.4920 a dollar level countered early selling pressure, dealers said on Monday.
They said there was also some stop-loss selling of the ringgit against the Singapore dollar from London.
"The market is trapped in a range. Many U.S. funds are still covering their short positions established right from 2.5250 down," said a dealer with an European bank in Singapore.
He said the ringgit could ease another 50 points overnight in thin London and New York markets if dollar/ringgit broke above 2.4920 a dollar.
Dealers said the ringgit was in an extended correction mode after touching a high of 2.4680 on January 13.
"Dollar/ringgit will trade to a high of 2.4950/5050 before the next ringgit rally can start," one dealer said.
Dealers said a survey by research firm I.D.E.A. predicting ringgit's rise to 2.475/480 a dollar level in one week and to 2.4650 in one month was having a negative impact.
"It is a usual thing, when everybody thinks ringgit is going to gain, then it first moves in the opposite direction," said the head of dealing at a foreign bank in Kuala Lumpur.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4897/07 a dollar.
